From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>

Subject: Service-level uplift & capacity playbook — QBR scheduling

Hi Asha / Ryan,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our call, I wanted to kick off a focused renewal/expansion thread so we can land a concrete timeline for the QBR and agree next steps for the proposed service-level uplift and capacity headroom. High-level items I propose we cover in the QBR:

- Current usage and projected token/throughput growth (you shared 3x over the next 12 months)
- Options for a 12-month term with stepped capacity commitments (burst lanes + baseline)
- SLA tiers and what changes operationally (latency SLO, priority routing, incident playbook)
- Migration/runbook for any model routing or quantization changes
- Commercial terms: pricing for baseline vs burst, credits, and amortization of enablement costs

Attached is a first-draft capacity playbook and a simple forecast we put together based on yesterday's figures. Stephanie (cc) will lead the runbook/ops portion and Marissa will help coordinate the QBR logistics.

Can you confirm:
1) Who from BlueWave should attend the QBR (SRE, product, procurement, legal)?
2) Which of these windows work for you for a 60–75 minute QBR next month: June 9th (10–11:15 PT), June 10th (11–12:15 PT), or June 15th (9–10:15 PT)?
3) Any hard constraints on contract term or procurement deadlines we should be aware of?

If it helps, we can also prepare a one-pager comparing the SLA tiers and the expected cost delta for the uplift.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
David Kim
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi David — thanks for pulling this together.

Quick answers:
- Attendees: I will bring our Head of SRE (Ryan), Product (Lena Ortiz), and procurement (procurement@bluewave.com). Legal wants to sit in for commercial term conversations but will be optional unless we get to redlines.
- Windows: June 10th 11–12:15 PT works best for us. Please pencil that and we'll confirm once we receive the formal invite.
- Constraints: Procurement is working toward an end-of-June PO deadline; if we can get principal terms agreed before June 24th that would be ideal.

A one-pager on SLA tiers would be very helpful. Can you include estimated cost delta for the different SLOs? That will speed up procurement signoff.

Thanks,
Asha Mehta
VP, Engineering — BlueWave Payments

Folks — Asha confirmed June 10th (11–12:15 PT) and noted procurement's end-of-June PO target.

Stephanie: can you lead the runbook + ops slides? Key asks for the QBR:
- One slide on how we guarantee the latency SLO and what fallback policies look like (model variants, region failover)
- Runbook steps for incident + capacity spike: owner, escalation path, timeline to restore degraded throughput
- A short ops checklist for BlueWave to validate before a term change (prefix cache, tokenization limits, test plan)

Marissa: please send a calendar invite to BlueWave for June 10th, include a tentative agenda and attach the playbook + SLA one-pager once I have it updated. Also flag legal for a quick pre-read in case we need term amendments.

I also want to propose a commercial framing for our internal alignment: 12-month term, baseline X units/month (see forecast), with a 2x burst pool and optional add-on seats for peak days. We'll produce a pricing matrix showing baseline vs burst economics.

I'll draft the SLA one-pager tonight and attach the updated PDF in the QBR invite.

Thanks — David

- Draft the SLO guarantees slide and a short appendix for the runbook (owner matrix + escalation flow)
- Pull in SRE engineering lead (Arjun Patel) to validate the failover timelines and burst gating approach
- Create a short pre-read checklist BlueWave can run against their staging environment (KV cache priming, tokenization sanity checks, perf test runbook)

Marissa — can you block a 75-minute slot for June 10th (11–12:15 PT + 15 min buffer) and include Arjun, me, David, Asha, Ryan, Lena Ortiz, and procurement? I'll aim to share the ops appendix by EOD June 4th.

One ask on terms: if procurement is pushing a June 24th PO deadline, we should decide whether to route a term amendment (12-month) now or start with an interim addendum that locks baseline capacity and pricing pending final legal redlines. Legal will need both options ready.
